clips.title: Vāgdhenu : maṅgala 1
clips.text: लक्ष्मीर्यस्य परिग्रहः कमलभूः सूनुर्गरुत्मान् रथः पौत्रश्चंद्रविभूषणः सुरगुरु शेषश्च शय्या पुनः ब्रह्मांडं वरमंदिरं सुरगणाः यस्य प्रभोः सेवकाः स त्रैलोक्यकुटुंबपालनपरः कुर्याद्धरिर्मंगलम्
clips.transliteration: lakṣmīryasya parigrahaḥ kamalabhūḥ sūnurgarutmān rathaḥ pautraścandravibhūṣaṇaḥ suraguru śeṣaśca śayyā punaḥ brahmāṇḍaṃ varamandiraṃ suragaṇāḥ yasya prabhoḥ sevakāḥ sa trailokyakuṭuṃbapālanaparaḥ kuryāddharirmaṅgalam
clips.attribution: Vāgdhenu Sanskrit Chant Corpus (prathoshap/vagdhenu-data), reciter: corpus author (single speaker), license CC-BY-4.0

clips.title: Vāgdhenu : Mahābhārata Tatparya Nirṇaya
clips.text: यो वेद निहितं गुहायां परमे व्योमन् सोऽश्नुते सर्वान् कामान् सह ब्रह्मणा विपश्चिता
clips.transliteration: yo veda nihitaṃ guhāyāṃ parame vyoman so'shnute sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā
clips.attribution: Vāgdhenu Sanskrit Chant Corpus (prathoshap/vagdhenu-data), reciter: corpus author (single speaker), license CC-BY-4.0

clips.title: Vāgdhenu : Sumadhvavijaya (śloka)
clips.text: अजाय जनयित्रेस्य विजिताखिलदानव अजादिपूज्यपादाय नमस्ते गरुडध्वज
clips.transliteration: ajāya janayitre'sya vijitākhiladānava ajādipūjyapādāya namaste garuḍadhvaja
clips.attribution: Vāgdhenu Sanskrit Chant Corpus (prathoshap/vagdhenu-data), reciter: corpus author (single speaker), license CC-BY-4.0

clips.title: Vāgdhenu : Sumadhvavijaya (stuti)
clips.text: विप्रमुख्यैः सदा वेदवादोन्मुखैः सुप्रतापैः क्षितीशेश्वरैश्चार्चितम् अप्रतर्क्योरुसंविद्गुणं निर्मलं सुप्रकाशाजरानन्दरूपं परम् प्रीणयामो वासुदेवं देवतामण्डलाखण्डमण्डनम्
clips.transliteration: vipramukhyaiḥ sadā vedavādonmukhaiḥ supratāpaiḥ kṣitīśeśvaraiścārcitam apratarkyourusaṃvidguṇaṃ nirmalaṃ suprakāśājarānandarūpaṃ param prīṇayāmo vāsudevaṃ devatāmaṇḍalākhaṇḍamaṇḍanam
clips.attribution: Vāgdhenu Sanskrit Chant Corpus (prathoshap/vagdhenu-data), reciter: corpus author (single speaker), license CC-BY-4.0

clips.title: Vedavani : Atharvaveda Kanda 10.1
clips.text: यां कल्पयन्ति वहतौ वधूमिव विश्वरूपां हस्तकृतां चिकित्सवः
clips.transliteration: yāṃ kalpayanti vahatau vadhūmiva viśvarūpāṃ hastakṛtāṃ cikitsavaḥ
clips.attribution: Vedavani: A Benchmark Corpus for ASR on Vedic Sanskrit Poetry (ACL 2025, arXiv:2506.00145), transcribed from the Rig Veda and Atharva Veda, license Apache-2.0

clips.title: Vedavani : Atharvaveda Kanda 10.3
clips.text: शीर्षण्वती नस्वती कर्णिणी कृत्याकृता संभृता विश्वरूपा
clips.transliteration: śīrṣaṇvatī nasvatī karṇiṇī kṛtyākṛtā saṃbhṛtā viśvarūpā
clips.attribution: Vedavani: A Benchmark Corpus for ASR on Vedic Sanskrit Poetry (ACL 2025, arXiv:2506.00145), transcribed from the Rig Veda and Atharva Veda, license Apache-2.0

clips.title: Vedavani : Rigveda 47.259
clips.text: सो चिन्नु सख्या नर्य इन स्तुतश्चर्कृत्य इन्द्रो मावते नरे
clips.transliteration: so cinna sakhyā narya ina stutaścarkṛtya indro māvate nare
clips.attribution: Vedavani: A Benchmark Corpus for ASR on Vedic Sanskrit Poetry (ACL 2025, arXiv:2506.00145), transcribed from the Rig Veda and Atharva Veda, license Apache-2.0
